questions.question: Which write strategy should the cache use?

options.label: Write-through
options.description: Writes reach the cache and the store together.

options.label: Write-behind
options.description: Writes reach the cache first, the store later.

questions.question: Which eviction policies should it support?

options.label: LRU
options.description: Evict the least recently used entry.

options.label: LFU
options.description: Evict the least frequently used entry.

options.label: TTL
options.description: Evict entries after a fixed time to live.
